sample_unit: patient questions (responses from each of 3 models)

links.outcome: Reading grade level of LLM responses versus 6th grade AMA/NIH recommendation
links.effect: All responses exceeded the 6th grade threshold (FKGL >6). Gemini FKGL 16.2±2.2, ChatGPT 14.4±1.6, Grok 14.6±1.7.
links.quote: All responses exceeded the AMA/NIH 6th grade reading level threshold (FKGL >6).

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient education responses versus recommended level
links.effect: All responses exceeded the AMA/NIH 6th grade level; mean FKGL 14.4-16.2 across models, far above recommendations.
links.quote: AI models generated generally accurate information about UCL repair but at reading levels far above the AMA/NIH recommendations.

links.outcome: Surgeon-rated accuracy of LLM answers to UCL repair patient questions (CRRS, AIRM)
links.effect: More than minimal clarification needed for 15% ChatGPT, 5% Gemini, 40% Grok responses; Gemini CRRS 1.5±0.5 vs ChatGPT 2.0±0.4 and Grok 2.1±0.7.
links.quote: More than minimal clarification was required for 15% (3/20) of ChatGPT, 5% (1/20) of Gemini, and 40% (8/20) of Grok responses.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and readability of LLM responses (ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) to common patient questions regarding ulnar collateral ligament repair without testing an intervention or guardrail.
